el.Casi todos los proyectos holísticos que: Almost every holistic project that isn't growing has the same diagnosis: they post a lot but have no clear offer. There's content, there are followers, there's enthusiasm — and there's no defined product, no price, no next step to offer the person who found you.

el.Cada bloque termina con algo hecho, no c: Every block ends with something done, not just something understood. We work live on your own project.
el.Cómo pensar tus productos: How to think about your products
el.La grilla de cuatro productos que funcio: The four-product grid that works in this field: free hook, entry product, core product and recurring product. What goes in each box, why a single drop-in class isn't a product but a membership is, and how to set a price with a floor, a ceiling and a middle number.
el.Te llevás tu grilla con 4 productos y 4: You take home your grid with 4 products and 4 prices
el.El calendario de 14 días: qué se publica: The 14-day calendar: what to post each day, in what order, when to open and when to close. Presale, limited spots and closing date — why without a closing date there is no launch. The three closing messages, written.
el.Te llevás tu lanzamiento fechado en el c: You take home your launch, scheduled on the calendar
el.Cómo hacer contenido que engancha: How to make content that hooks
el.Los tres segundos: qué frena el scroll y: The first three seconds: what stops the scroll and what doesn't. The five formats that work in holistic projects and that you'll use again and again. What NOT to do: the quote over a sunset photo, the "good morning, beautiful community", the carousel that defines a concept, the video of the whole class with no context. And how to produce in batches: one day a month, twelve pieces.
el.Te llevás 5 ideas escritas con el gancho: You take home 5 written ideas with the hook defined
el.Cómo pedir el siguiente paso: How to ask for the next step
el.El llamado a la acción que no da vergüen: The call to action that doesn't feel embarrassing: where it goes, how many times it's repeated and in what words. The costliest mistake in this field is having attention and proposing nothing.
el.Cuatro casos del grupo, en vivo. Qué fun: Four cases from the group, live. What worked, what didn't and why.
el.Cómo armar una campaña de mensajes: How to build a messages campaign
el.Objetivo, público, presupuesto, creativo: Objective, audience, budget, creative and text template. What to reply when a message comes in: the script for the first three responses. How much a message costs and when to pause a campaign.
el.Te llevás la campaña armada: You take home your campaign, built
el.Cómo armar una campaña de seguidores: How to build a followers campaign
el.Cuándo sirve y cuándo es plata tirada. C: When it's worth it and when it's money down the drain. How it's really set up, because the "followers" objective doesn't exist: it's solved with profile traffic or engagement.
el.Cómo armar una campaña de venta: How to build a sales campaign
el.Público frío y retargeting: qué anuncio: Cold audience and retargeting: which ad each one sees. The real minimum budget and how many days before the launch to switch it on.
el.Qué te rechaza Meta y cómo se escribe ig: What Meta rejects and how to write it anyway
el.Políticas de atributos personales: por q: Personal attributes policies: why "Do you suffer from anxiety?" gets your ad taken down and how to say exactly the same thing in an approvable way. A critical block for this field.
el.Te llevás tus textos corregidos: You take home your corrected copy
el.Qué mirar cada semana: What to look at every week
el.Las cuatro métricas que importan y ningu: The four metrics that matter and no others. How to read them without losing your mind.
You leave with tools, not notes.
el.La plantilla para ordenar tus cuatro pro: The template to organize your four products and their prices.
el.Los 14 días, día por día, listos para co: All 14 days, day by day, ready for you to fill in with your dates.
el.Las estructuras de contenido que funcion: The content structures that work in this field, with examples.
el.El paso a paso de mensajes, seguidores y: The step-by-step for messages, followers and sales.
el.Qué contestar en los primeros tres mensa: What to answer in the first three WhatsApp messages.
el.Newsletter semanal, comunidad de WhatsAp: Weekly newsletter, WhatsApp community and monthly lab.

el.Aporta la mirada del mundo holístico: có: Brings the perspective of the holistic world: how a practice is sustained, how a real community is built, and how to get through the discomfort of selling without betraying what you teach.
